concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-apac-statements-reconciliation]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted APAC statements and daily Transaction Detail Report route covering monthly availability, settlement-currency disbursement details, permission-gated access and fee-qualified reconciliation; captured APAC account/pricing/timing guidance, not Australian transfer authority, current independent bank policy, a bank guarantee, or proof that a deposit arrived
warnings: Keep the reciprocal route within the captured APAC account, settlement-currency, pricing, fee and timing scope.
Do not treat reconciliation arithmetic or disbursement-date language as Australian transfer guidance, a current bank guarantee, or proof of an individual deposit.
